summary: Ease of Movement: how far price moved per unit of volume, smoothed with a 14-bar SMA, around zero.
overview: Ease of Movement (EOM), by Richard Arms, shows how easily price moves, in its own pane. High positive values mean price rose on light volume; large negative values mean it fell easily.
The line is green above zero and red below.
how: Distance moved = (high + low) / 2 - (previous high + previous low) / 2. Box ratio = (volume / 10000) / (high - low). One-bar EMV = distance / box ratio. EOM = SMA(EMV, 14).
The divisor (10000) only scales the line.
use: Some traders watch EOM above zero as price rising with little effort.
Use zero-line crosses as a change in direction of easy movement.
Look at values near zero as heavy volume for little movement.
Pair it with price structure to judge breakouts.
alerts: Alerts: you can alert on its line crossing a value or the candle close (from the chart's + menu); checked while ZoroCharts is open.
notes: It needs volume data; on symbols without volume it shows nothing useful.
